response_semantics.counterfactual_semantics: The historical state at T is factual. Baseline and intervention futures are simulated; alternative strategy outcomes are counterfactual estimates and not observed ground truth. No historical future is used.
limitations: No traffic/overtaking model: ordering is free-air (laps DESC, race_time ASC, driver_id); position changes are free-air rejoin estimates with no rejoin battle.
Phase-6 has no identified per-compound pace delta: an explicit compound changes only compound identity / stint grid / future transitions.
CRN shares per-(seed, index) stream identities, not trajectories; after divergence event ordering may differ, so CRN is not a universal variance reduction claim.
Counterfactual levels are not observable truth; S4 validates machinery, not realised intervention outcomes.
STAY_OUT is frequently behaviourally inert; a near-zero delta is not proof of strategic equivalence when the intervention rarely activated.
PIT_NOW can coincide with a baseline pit the driver was already due to make; pairing status cannot always separate an aligned replacement from a new forced stop.

S4 itself defines no sampling uncertainty; S5 exposes an additive, explicitly sampling-only paired SE / bootstrap interval over this result. It is not parameter, traffic, compound-effect or real-world counterfactual uncertainty.
Sampling intervals are exploratory Monte Carlo diagnostics; the many pairwise intervals are not a family-wise inferential procedure and no multiple-comparison correction or p-value is applied.
Classifications describe Monte Carlo sampling uncertainty only; they are not real-world causal or superiority claims.
A candidate-vs-candidate distinction uses a direct paired difference over the candidate A/B complete valid set; baseline validity is not required for it.

leader_by_point_estimate names only the highest simulator point estimate under the selected objective; it is not a recommendation. When the interval cannot distinguish a candidate from the leader it is listed in indistinguishable_from_leader.
Execution context (applied / suppressed / superseded / inert rates) is carried unchanged; a near-zero delta for a frequently inert or superseded intervention is not equivalence evidence.
A candidate may be worse than baseline; all candidates being INCONCLUSIVE or DEGRADATION is a valid result and no intervention is forced to be preferred.
